court_name: IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
summary: Dispute over specific performance of an agreement for sale of land with a tenanted building dated 20th January 2005. Buyer paid Rs. 25 lakh but failed to complete balance payment within four months. Sellers cancelled agreement citing time as essence; buyer claimed time not of essence, arguing obligation to vacate tenants first. Trial Court dismissed suit; High Court reversed, decreeing specific performance. Supreme Court examines readiness and willingness of buyer, timing of performance, and whether time was of essence. Key issues: validity of agreement, compliance with terms, conduct of parties, possession, and enforcement of specific performance.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 96 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; impugned judgment of High Court set aside; decree of Trial Court restored dismissing suit for specific performance.
